linework.observation: Bold clean outlines define the bald protagonist, chart table, pipework and sealed access hatch.

colour.observation: Restrained navy, steel gray, cream and warm tan; small red indicators remain localized.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows on skin and coveralls; steel highlights are simplified and illustrated.

character_construction.observation: Protagonist has the canonical bald rounded head, nose, ears, eyebrows and mouth; supporting crew have hair.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed chart room with a solid opaque overhead hatch, ladder, gauges and watertight fittings.

finish.observation: Clean focal hierarchy and polished contours; no visible artifacts.

identity.observation: The bald protagonist is clearly foregrounded between two distinct dark-haired crew members.

content.observation: The chart-table activity continues in an enclosed room; the overhead hatch is solid, with no exterior sky or water visible.

composition.observation: Foregrounded protagonist, full face visible; supporting crew and equipment remain secondary.

regions.people_faces: Bald protagonist writes at the foreground chart table; two dark-haired crew members work behind him.
regions.clothing: Three workers wear navy coveralls; baldness distinguishes the protagonist.
regions.foreground_props: Chart, pencil, mug and parallel dividers.
regions.architecture: Watertight hatch, ladder, piping and gauge panels; no transparent openings.
regions.distance: Supporting crew and equipment recede behind the foreground protagonist.
regions.lighting: Warm work light over a subdued steel-gray interior.
